scenarios.prompt: Compute EOQ. Annual demand D = 24,000 units. Order cost S = $250 per order. Holding cost H = $6 per unit per year. Lead time = 14 days. Report eoq, orders_per_year, total_annual_cost, and reorder_point (assume constant daily demand).

Annual demand 144,000 units. Order setup cost $380. Unit purchase cost is $36 and holding cost is quoted as 20% of unit cost per year (so H = 0.20 × 36 = $7.20). Lead time 21 days. Compute eoq, orders_per_year, total_annual_cost, reorder_point.
Annual demand 1000 units. Order cost $50. Holding cost is reported as $0 per unit (the warehouse is free, sunk cost). Compute EOQ.
